sentences.text: Foo Fighters is an American rock band , formed in Seattle , Washington in 1994 .	Seattle	Seattle	Washington	Washington (state)	rock	Rock music	Foo Fighters	Foo Fighters (album)

It was founded by Nirvana drummer Dave Grohl as a one-man project following the dissolution of Nirvana after the death of Kurt Cobain .	Dave Grohl	Dave Grohl	Nirvana	Nirvana (band)	death of	Death of Kurt Cobain	Kurt Cobain	Kurt Cobain

The group got its name from the UFOs and various aerial phenomena that were reported by Allied aircraft pilots in World War II , which were known collectively as `` foo fighters '' .	Allied aircraft pilots	Allies of World War II	World War II	World War II

Prior to the release of Foo Fighters ' 1995 debut album Foo Fighters , which featured Grohl as the only official member , Grohl recruited bassist Nate Mendel and drummer William Goldsmith , both formerly of Sunny Day Real Estate , as well as Nirvana touring guitarist Pat Smear to complete the lineup .	Nate Mendel	Nate Mendel	Nirvana	Nirvana (band)	Sunny Day Real Estate	Sunny Day Real Estate	Pat Smear	Pat Smear	William Goldsmith	William Goldsmith	Foo Fighters	Foo Fighters (album)
The band began with performances in Portland , Oregon .

Goldsmith quit during the recording of the group 's second album , The Colour and the Shape -LRB- 1997 -RRB- , when most of the drum parts were re-recorded by Grohl himself .	The Colour and the Shape	The Colour and the Shape
Smear 's departure followed soon afterward , though he would rejoin them in 2006 .

They were replaced by Taylor Hawkins and Franz Stahl , respectively , although Stahl was fired before the recording of the group 's third album , There Is Nothing Left to Lose -LRB- 1999 -RRB- .	Taylor Hawkins	Taylor Hawkins	Franz Stahl	Franz Stahl	There Is Nothing Left to Lose	There Is Nothing Left to Lose

The band briefly continued as a trio until Chris Shiflett joined as the band 's lead guitarist after the completion of There Is Nothing Left to Lose .	Chris Shiflett	Chris Shiflett	There Is Nothing Left to Lose	There Is Nothing Left to Lose
The band released its fourth album , One by One , in 2002 .	One by One	One by One (Foo Fighters album)
The group followed that release with the two-disc In Your Honor -LRB- 2005 -RRB- , which was split between acoustic songs and heavier material .	In Your Honor	In Your Honor	acoustic	Acoustic music
Foo Fighters released its sixth album , Echoes , Silence , Patience & Grace , in 2007 .	Foo Fighters	Foo Fighters (album)
The band 's seventh studio album , Wasting Light , produced by Butch Vig was released in 2011 , in which Smear returned as a full member .	Wasting Light	Wasting Light	Butch Vig	Butch Vig

In November 2014 , the band 's eighth studio album , Sonic Highways , was released as an accompanying soundtrack to the Grohl-directed 2014 miniseries of the same name .	Sonic Highways	Sonic Highways	2014 miniseries	Foo Fighters: Sonic Highways
Over the course of the band 's career , four of its albums have won Grammy Awards for Best Rock Album .	Best Rock Album	Grammy Award for Best Rock Album
As of 2015 , the band 's eight albums have sold 12 million copies in the U.S. , and 30 million worldwide .
